selection: fixed workload names, seeds, capacity cap; no answer filtering

controls.raw: original programs; no basis in execution core
controls.append: same learned basis available, original programs unchanged
controls.basis: learned basis with rewritten execution plans
controls.memo: original relations with canonical expression memoization

accounting: All processes include startup, input, both discovery phases, checking, query batches and output. No attached checkpoint; core/audit bytes use Python canonical S-expression encoding. Per-batch cache is cold at each batch. append is an experiment control, not the legacy a77 benchmark. Measurement views are not independently restorable snapshots.
